en: Clever Stratagem to Repel the Enemy

name.en: Clever Stratagem to Repel the Enemy

desc.zh: 马超带兵围攻天水，王异发来求援信。前往天水救援王异。
desc.en: Ma Chao leads troops to besiege Tianshui, and Wang Yi has sent a plea for aid. Head to Tianshui to reinforce Wang Yi.

story.zh: 马超渭水败退后投靠张鲁，并借兵攻打天水。守城的任务便落在了赵昂王异夫妇等人身上......
story.en: After his defeat at the Wei River, Ma Chao sought refuge with Zhang Lu and borrowed troops to attack Tianshui. The duty of defending the city fell upon Zhao Ang, his wife Wang Yi, and others...

forbidden.zh: 主角是王异、马超、赵昂时无法触发
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Wang Yi, Ma Chao, or Zhao Ang

participate.zh: 【与王异关系等级至少为3级且不足5级或身属曹操势力】，【与赵昂的关系等级不足5级】，【与马超关系等级不高于2级】，【天水属曹操】，【马超属于张鲁势力】，完成【忠贞礼节】和【渭南之战】
participate.en: 【Relationship level with Wang Yi is at least Level 3 and under Level 5, or affiliated with Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Relationship level with Zhao Ang is under Level 5】, 【Relationship level with Ma Chao is not higher than Level 2】, 【Tianshui belongs to Cao Cao】, 【Ma Chao belongs to Zhang Lu's Faction】, complete 【Loyal Propriety】 and 【Battle of Weinan】

conditions.zh: 王异：NPC关系等级 >= 3 或 玩家势力 = 曹操
conditions.en: Wang Yi: relationship level >= 3 or Player's faction = Cao Cao

name.en: Clever Stratagem to Repel the Enemy
